text:
elaine: Quick thread — brainstorming the benchmark launch narrative and the chart set. Thinking 3 core visuals + 1 hero claim. Short ideas below.
jorge: +1 on 3. what are you thinking for hero claim copy? concise, metric-forward.
elaine: Hero: 'Cut inference cost by up to 3x at SLO-level latency' — need to validate numbers but want it punchy.
sam: can we be more specific: e.g., '3x cost at 95pct latency' or 'tokens/$ at p95'? investors care general, users want the percentiles.
maria: inbound flow note — hero CTA should drive to an ROI calculator and webinar signup. we can gate the calculator behind email capture for mid-funnel leads.
neil: chart proposals: 1) tokens-per-dollar (y) vs model variant (x) with bars and error bars showing variance; 2) latency tail chart (p50/p90/p95/p99) small-multiples by model; 3) throughput per GPU vs concurrency heatmap. keep axes labeled, log-scale where needed.
elaine: good. prefer tokens-per-dollar as the most tangible unit. copy options: 'Tokens per dollar (higher is better)' or 'Inference tokens per $1'. which reads clearer?
jorge: 'Tokens per $' is terse for a viz label. in headline maybe spell out.
sam: also want a mini-chart showing quantized vs fp16 vs bf16 for same model — callout box: "quantization saves X%". that helps teams choose tradeoffs.
neil: yes, add an inset: same model, different quant levels. data team: can we get numbers by EOD Thu? I'll draft vis configs.
maria: webinar plan: 30m demo + 20m Q&A. marketing will run two promos: product newsletter + targeted ads to AI companies. Landing: webinar signup -> ROI calc -> 'book demo' or 'start free trial' CTAs. routing: trial signups flag leads for AE if usage > threshold in first 7 days.
elaine: routing thresholds? propose auto-handoff when first-week tokens > 50M OR sustained p95 < 200ms for 1k req/day (signals production intent).
jorge: those thresholds sound high for SMB. maybe have tiers: SMB handoff at 5M tokens, mid-market 50M, enterprise via sales.
maria: agreed — we'll map to lead score buckets. ops will implement tag code: lead_score: bench_campaign_x.
ops-bot: reminder: content freeze for landing page is Fri 09:00 PT.
sam: chart copy: include a short methods blurb under visuals: 'Tested on public model weights (vX) on NVIDIA A100 / q4_0 quant. Pipeline: 1k synthetic prompts, mean token length 32.' want that exact phrasing?
neil: tweak to avoid over-specific hardware claims — legal check. maybe 'tested on commonly-used GPU instances; see appendix for test params.'
elaine: action items: 1) neil to produce mockups (Thu EOD). 2) data (sam) to hand numbers (Thu EOD). 3) maria to draft landing + routing flows (Fri AM). 4) jorge to tighten hero copy and 2 alt headlines (Thu). i'll coordinate webinar invite copy.
jorge: I'll push two hero variants by afternoon.
sam: data note — we'll include variance bars and raw table in appendix CSV for transparency.
maria: for promos, add a small A/B test: CTA 'See your inference ROI' vs 'How much can you save on inference?'. we'll run to email segment 1.
elaine: love it. last ask: keep one stat that's unmissable for social: short line and number e.g., 'Reduce inference spend by 2.8x — typical across workloads'. don't exaggerate.
neil: I'll make the visuals friendly for social crops (square + 16:9).
ops-bot: scheduled: landing page content freeze Fri 09:00 PT — automated reminder will fire Thu 17:00 PT.
elaine: perfect. if no objections i'll lock in the chart slate and hero by EOD. thanks all :rocket:
